note: The frozen half of OER-05. Nothing a submission says may move any number in this file. The verifier reads its own copy of it at grading time, and tests/Dockerfile refuses to build unless the two copies are byte-identical.

budget.note: FIXED in tokens and in forward/backward passes, and fixed in optimizer steps too. Unlike a recipe task, this slot does not let a submission trade accumulation against step count: grad_accum is frozen at 1 so that every update rule is judged over exactly 3072 applications of itself. Every submission therefore costs the same FLOPs and very nearly the same wall clock.

init.note: Every run in this task starts from the same parameter tensors. The update rule is the only thing that differs between two runs.

schedule.note: FROZEN. The step-size envelope is not the free axis of this slot -- the update rule is. Every run, the shipped default, the private reference and the submission alike, multiplies its own per-role step size by exactly this envelope: a 5 percent linear warmup, then hold, then linear decay to zero over the last 45 percent. A submission chooses the magnitude of its step sizes; it does not choose their shape over time.

evaluation.metric: mean token-level cross-entropy in nats, lower is better
evaluation.note: The graded split is NOT in the agent image. environment/data/devset_slice.bin is a proxy cut from a different FineWeb training shard and is the agent's own yardstick; it is never the graded number.

data.format: FineWeb10B GPT-2 BPE. 1024-byte int32 header (magic 20240520, version 1, token count), then uint16 token ids.
data.train_slice_note: Exactly the 25165824 tokens the budget consumes, plus one for the shifted target. There is no extra training data to find; the budget rather than the corpus is the scarce thing here.
